threat_event: CAD is unavailable for days and crews run on radio and paper, delaying responses
threat_source: Ransomware, region failure, or failed change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CAD standby outside provider A; manual mode drilled only for a few hours
existing_controls: Manual dispatch binders; radio; cross-center routing
treatment_plan: Multi-day manual dispatch drill with counties; station-level paper run tickets; CAD standby (GR-01)

threat_event: Attacker takes over vehicle routers through exposed remote administration and reaches the CAD tunnel
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found 41 routers with remote web administration open on the cellular interface and the factory default password; shared tunnel key
treatment_plan: Close remote administration and change passwords on all routers (done for the 41 by 2026-08-21); fleet-wide baseline; per-device certificates

threat_event: Actions on mobile data computers cannot be traced to a crew member
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared CAD account per vehicle
treatment_plan: Crew sign-in on the MDC through SYS-G1 with badge tap

threat_event: Ransomware on station and office endpoints disrupts crew operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station shared workstations; mixed device ages
treatment_plan: Retire shared station workstations; kiosk mode for remaining ones
owner: Ambulance Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: ePCR outage delays hospital record delivery beyond state deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ePCR vendor; paper fallback depends on crews
regulatory_driver: State EMS records rules (Florida worked example: Rule 64J-1.014, F.A.C.)
existing_controls: Offline tablets; paper records; vendor secondary region
treatment_plan: Weekly delivery exception report; downtime record delivery procedure by state

threat_event: Lost or stolen ePCR tablet exposes patient records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,900 tablets in vehicles
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; device management
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes a breach unlikely (unsecured PHI test in 164.402)
owner: Ambulance Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: 12-lead relay outage or breach delays heart attack alerts or exposes ECGs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single relay vendor; no monitoring of relay availability
treatment_plan: Relay availability alert to the clinical supervisor; radio report procedure refreshed

threat_event: Vulnerable cardiac monitor firmware is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monitors patched only at vendor service visits
existing_controls: Monitors reach only the vendor relay
treatment_plan: Add monitors to the fleet inventory with firmware versions; vendor patch schedule in the contract

threat_event: Crew members view ePCR records of patients they did not treat
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ePCR search allows any crew member in a region to find records
treatment_plan: Limit search to assigned incidents; break-glass with reason

threat_event: Per-diem field staff keep ePCR access after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Per-diem departures entered late in HR
existing_controls: Federated access disabled on HR event
treatment_plan: Monthly per-diem activity check; auto-suspend after 30 days without a shift

threat_event: AI narrative drafting puts inaccurate statements in patient care records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot on 300 tablets; crews may accept drafts without editing
existing_controls: Crew must edit and sign; pilot only
treatment_plan: Monthly accuracy sampling; pilot limited until targets are met (P10)

threat_event: The unit posting model leaves some neighborhoods with longer response times
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model optimizes average response time across the county
treatment_plan: Response-time equity metric by zone; council review (P10)

threat_event: Ambulance misses county notice duties during a dispatch outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: County contacts in 38 agreements kept by local managers
treatment_plan: Central county notice register in the P08 matrix and center binders

threat_event: Hurricane damages stations and vehicles and cuts cellular service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coastal stations; cellular dependence
treatment_plan: Satellite backup on supervisor vehicles; pre-storm relocation plan

threat_event: Cellular carrier outage removes MDC data and vehicle location
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier per vehicle in most regions
existing_controls: Radio status; dual-carrier routers in 2 states
treatment_plan: Dual-carrier routers fleet-wide at the next replacement cycle

threat_event: Phishing gives an attacker a field employee's account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field staff read email on personal phones
treatment_plan: Mobile-specific phishing training; managed app for email
owner: Ambulance Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Medicare documentation is not retained 7 years and claims are denied or recouped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Physician certification statements arrive by fax and email in some regions
existing_controls: BDS attaches most statements to the billing record
treatment_plan: Attach every statement before claim release; 7-year retention in the revenue cycle platform

threat_event: State EMS data submissions fail silently
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Submission confirmations checked monthly
treatment_plan: Weekly confirmation check

threat_event: Patient care records are released to law enforcement without a permitted basis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station staff receive requests directly
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R04; HIPAA Privacy Rule 164.512(f); Fla. Stat. 401.30(4) (worked example)
treatment_plan: Route all requests to the Privacy Office; training for station supervisors

threat_event: Crew scheduling service outage leaves ambulances unstaffed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single scheduling vendor
treatment_plan: Weekly schedule export to stations

threat_event: MDCs running an operating system near end of support are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 600 MDCs on an older operating system
treatment_plan: Replace or upgrade the 600 MDCs by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Station Wi-Fi shared with personal devices exposes station workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some stations have one Wi-Fi network
treatment_plan: Separate guest network at all stations

threat_event: A bad configuration push breaks MDCs or routers fleet-wide
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fleet changes are outside group change management
treatment_plan: Fleet changes through the group change board with a pilot group

threat_event: ePCR records are delivered to the wrong hospital
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hospital mapping tables maintained by hand
treatment_plan: Quarterly mapping review

threat_event: Crews share tablet sign-ins at shift change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shift changes happen in the field
treatment_plan: Badge tap sign-in on tablets

threat_event: Changes to dispatch protocol settings in the CAD are made without clinical approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Protocol determinants are configured by CAD administrators
existing_controls: Medical director review of major updates
treatment_plan: Protocol table changes require chief medical officer approval in the change record

threat_event: Printed face sheets left in vehicles are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Facility face sheets printed for transfers
treatment_plan: Accepted: low volume and low sensitivity beyond what the ePCR holds

threat_event: A breach at the router management cloud vendor pushes malicious firmware to the fleet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor has not been reviewed
treatment_plan: Vendor security review; firmware signing check; staged updates
